items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I played with John Handy a long time.

ctx.x: Let's see, who else? What about John Handy? Did you ever work with him? John Handy?
I played with John Handy a long time.
You're trying to remember if he was in your band when I used to see him? No, I was in, I played. You and him?
